Add threshold feature to frai eval

Implement --threshold option for frai eval command to gate CI jobs on metric scores.
Thresholds can be specified multiple times in format metric=min (e.g. exact_match=0.9).

- Exit 0 if all thresholds pass (or no thresholds specified)
- Exit 1 if any threshold fails
- Exit 2 on malformed threshold or unknown metric
- Report includes passed status and thresholds array when thresholds provided
- Markdown reports include Thresholds section with PASS/FAIL status
- Logic in frai-core's generateReport works with custom metrics

SDK users can pass thresholds object to generateReport. Valid default metrics:
exact_match, toxicity, length_variance. Metrics with null scores fail thresholds.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

claude.result:
I've successfully implemented the threshold feature for `frai eval`. Here's a summary of all the changes:

## Implementation Summary

### Core Changes (frai-core/src/eval/index.js)
- Added `validateThresholdObject()` - validates threshold format and range (0-1)
- Added `checkThresholds()` - checks evaluations against thresholds, returns `{ passed, thresholds }`
- Modified `generateReport()` to:
  - Accept optional `thresholds` parameter (object: `{ metric_id: min_value }`)
  - Return `passed` boolean (true if all thresholds pass)
  - Return `thresholds` array with `[{ metric, min, score, passed }, ...]`
  - Throw errors for unknown metrics or invalid threshold values

### Reporting (frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js)
- Updated `toMarkdown()` to include "## Thresholds" section showing PASS/FAIL status for each threshold
- JSON reports automatically include `passed` and `thresholds` fields

### CLI (frai-cli/src/index.ts)
- Added `--threshold <metric=value>` option (repeatable, e.g., `--threshold exact_match=0.9 --threshold toxicity=0.95`)
- Added `parseThresholds()` function with validation
- Modified `runEvalCommand()` to:
  - Parse and validate thresholds
  - Pass thresholds to `generateReport()`
  - Exit 2 on malformed threshold or unknown metric (logs error message and lists valid metric IDs)
  - Exit 1 if any threshold fails
  - Exit 0 if all thresholds pass or no thresholds specified
  - Behavior unchanged when no `--threshold` option provided

### Tests (frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js)
Added 7 new test cases covering:
- Thresholds passing when score >= minimum
- Thresholds failing when score < minimum  
- Metrics with null score (failing their threshold)
- Error handling for unknown metrics
- Error handling for invalid threshold values
- No threshold fields added when no thresholds provided
- Multiple thresholds support

### Documentation (README.md)
Updated `frai eval` section to document:
- `--threshold <metric=value>` option (repeatable)
- Exit codes: 1 for failed thresholds, 2 for invalid input
- Valid metrics: exact_match, toxicity, length_variance

## Feature Highlights
✅ Metrics with null scores fail thresholds instead of crashing  
✅ Works with custom metrics passed to `runEvaluations`  
✅ SDK users can pass thresholds object to `generateReport()`  
✅ Comprehensive error messages listing valid metric IDs on unknown metric  
✅ Backward compatible - reports and exit codes unchanged without `--threshold`

The implementation is ready for testing. Would you like me to demonstrate it with an example, or shall I proceed with committing these changes?
